subject: ACME procurement next steps — commercial path & PO details
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>; Procurement <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: ACME procurement next steps — commercial path & PO details

Hi Jordan / ACME procurement team,

Thanks again for the call today — great to meet everyone and understand the scope for the POC (higher-throughput embeddings and chat workflows for customer support routing). Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Recap: 3-month POC, targeting ~1M input tokens/month initially, expected to scale to 5M tokens/month if the POC validates.
- Commercial path: you're evaluating PO vs. corporate card for payment. You also mentioned potential interest in using the AWS Marketplace (or other cloud marketplace) if available.
- Procurement asks: ACME will need SOC 2 evidence, a DPA, and a vendor W-9; timeline for issuing a PO would help planning.

Action items / asks from ACME:
1) Confirm whether procurement prefers a PO (preferred) or can accept corporate card for the initial POC.
2) Share the procurement contact and any PO form or invoice instructions.
3) Confirm interest in Marketplace purchase (we can provide a marketplace SKU if that simplifies approvals).
4) If PO, an expected date when the PO would be routed/approved.

Attachments: Redwood_pricing_v2.pdf (pricing + POC terms), Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft.docx. Also attaching a blank ACME_PO_template.pdf if helpful for your legal/procurement team.

Proposed next step: I can do a 15-min sync with your procurement contact later this week to walk payment options and timelines — what days/times work?

Thanks,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

--
Redwood Inference — Production-first LLM inference (latency, cost, reliability)

From: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME procurement next steps — commercial path & PO details

Thanks Marissa — great call. A few quick items from procurement's side:

1) Procurement will prefer a PO for tracking and internal approvals. Card payment may be possible for a small pilot, but procurement needs sign-off and prefers PO.
2) Please send SOC 2 and the DPA (we need those for our vendor review).
3) We are interested in marketplace options if you have an AWS Marketplace listing — that would significantly speed approvals.
4) Our procurement contact is Janine Park (janine.park@acmecorp.com). Can you loop her in?

If you can send the requested docs today, I can kick this over to Janine so she can tell me the expected PO timeline.

—Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Senior Program Manager, ACME Corp
j.ellis@acmecorp.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Ellis <j.ellis@acmecorp.com>; Janine Park <janine.park@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-02T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: ACME procurement next steps — commercial path & PO details

Hi Jordan / Janine,

Looping Janine in — thanks for the quick reply.

Janine — welcome. A couple notes to make the review easier:
- We support both PO and card: PO is our standard for enterprise contracts; we can accept card for short-term pilots if procurement prefers.
- Marketplace: we don't yet have an active AWS Marketplace SKU for this product version, but it's in our roadmap; we can prioritize if that's critical for ACME.
- Documents attached: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_draft.docx, Redwood_pricing_v2.pdf, ACME_PO_template.pdf (blank).

Practical next steps:
1) If PO — please send the PO form or instructions and an estimated routing/approval date. Our finance team (Rachel Kim, copied) will create the initial invoice once we have the PO number.
2) If card — we can provision a short-term trial invoice and accept card to get the POC started quickly while procurement completes PO work.
3) If marketplace is required, let us know and we'll discuss internal prioritization for a marketplace listing (may add ~2–4 weeks).

I'm happy to jump on a 15-min call with procurement this week to walk the PO flow and answer any SOC/DPA questions. Proposed windows: Thu 3/4 10–11am PT or Fri 3/5 2–3pm PT. Which works best?

Related: HubSpot deal HS-12345 (https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-12345). I can also send a DocuSign link to streamline signature once the SOW/PO is ready.

Thanks — Marissa

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_report_2025.pdf; Redwood_DPA_draft.docx; Redwood_pricing_v2.pdf; ACME_PO_template.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-03-03T08:15:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: ACME procurement — PO path and marketplace interest (quick)

Quick internal note:
- ACME procurement prefers PO. They flagged marketplace as a potential preference but Janine confirmed she's not sure if procurement will require it.
- Action items: Rachel — please be ready to generate invoice once we have a PO number; include standard POC terms (Net 30). Vivek — FYI they may ask for a marketplace SKU; can we route a priority request to product if needed? Rishi — if we need a one-off credit or expedited billing exception for a POC on card, can you approve up to $5k?

I'll follow up with Janine to schedule the 15-min PO walk-through.

—Marissa
